gloss: as much as one wants, unlimited

definitions.gloss: as much as one wants, all-you-can, unlimited
definitions.explanation: Suffix attached to verb stems to indicate doing something without limit or restriction.

examples.japanese: {食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい}のレストランに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to an all-you-can-eat restaurant.

examples.japanese: {飲|の}み{放題|ほうだい}は{二時間|にじかん}です。
{言|い}い{放題|ほうだい}に{言|い}う。

notes:
FORMATION: Verb stem + {放題|ほうだい}

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい} (all-you-can-eat)
- {飲|の}み{放題|ほうだい} (all-you-can-drink)
- {使|つか}い{放題|ほうだい} (unlimited use)
- {見|み}{放題|ほうだい} (watch as much as you want)
- {歌|うた}い{放題|ほうだい} (sing as much as you want - karaoke)

NUANCE: When describing someone's behavior (like {言|い}い{放題|ほうだい}), it often carries a negative connotation of being unrestrained or inconsiderate.

CULTURAL NOTE: {食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい} and {飲|の}み{放題|ほうだい} are extremely popular in Japan, especially at izakaya ({居酒屋|いざかや}) and buffet restaurants.
